urls.description: Join us as we knock on doors for Congressman Frank Mrvan in Portage. We will talk to friends and neighbors to encourage them to participate in the November Midterm Election! We will meet at the launch location to hand out materials, train volunteers on how to speak to voters, and answer any questions you might have! Bring comfortable shoes, a friend, and a bottle of water! We look forward to getting out the vote with you! Sign up to receive location details.
